senses.en: the gradual change and development of an idea, situation, or object
examples: [[Evolution]] of language is the gradual change in human language over time.
The emergence of language was a defining moment in the [[evolution]] of modern humans.

senses.en: the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time
examples: [[Evolution]] of language is the gradual change in human language over time.
The emergence of language was a defining moment in the [[evolution]] of modern humans.

senses.en: very informal words and expressions that are more common in spoken language, esp. used by a particular group of people, e.g. children, soldiers
examples: These are some [[slang]] words teens might use when talking about other people.

senses.en: a short form of a word or expression
examples: The styling of [[abbreviations]] is inconsistent and includes many possible variations.

senses.en: make sth. bigger or looser by pulling it, or become bigger or looser as a result of being pulled
examples: A spider's web can [[stretch]] considerably without weakening.

senses.zh: 众筹（向大众募集资金的做法，常在因特网上进行）

senses.en: (infml.)
the activity of sending Internet or text messages that threaten or insult sb.
examples: The school provides guidance for parents on how to deal with issues such as [[cyberbullying]].

senses.en: (fml.) (only before noun) existing before a particular time or event
examples: But, this research doesn't consider the effects of [[pre-existing]] relationships.

senses.en: when you become involved with sb. / sth. in order to understand them
examples: Virtual employee [[engagement]] activities are ways to improve the relationship between an organization and its remote workers.
The man knew about the [[engagement]] and brought them a bottle of champagne as a gift.

senses.en: an agreement between two people to marry, or the period of time they are engaged
examples: Virtual employee [[engagement]] activities are ways to improve the relationship between an organization and its remote workers.
The man knew about the [[engagement]] and brought them a bottle of champagne as a gift.

senses.en: if a process accelerates or if sth. accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect
examples: More efforts will be made in the years ahead to [[accelerate]] the agricultural reform.

senses.en: the vocabulary of a person, language, or branch of knowledge
examples: The word "cloud" is attached to many terms in the computing [[lexicon]].

senses.zh: 回头见（用于电子邮件和手机短信中）
senses.en: (ta-ta for now) (BrE, infml.) used in emails and text messages to say goodbye to sb.
examples: Anyway, [[TTFN]], and hopefully I'll have plenty of time to write when I get back.

senses.en: find the origins of when sth. began or where it came from
examples: The style of these paintings can be [[traced]] back to early medieval influences.
Police are trying to [[trace]] a young woman who was seen near the accident.

senses.en: find sb. / sth. that has disappeared by searching for them carefully
examples: The style of these paintings can be [[traced]] back to early medieval influences.
Police are trying to [[trace]] a young woman who was seen near the accident.

senses.zh: 噢，呀（幽默用法，意识到自己做错事或说错话时发出的感叹语）
senses.en: (also d'oh) (spoken) used humorously when you have just realized that you have done or said sth. stupid
examples: "[[Doh]]! That was the biggest mistake in my career," said Jack.

senses.zh: （通常按字母顺序排列的）姓名地址录，名录，电话簿
senses.en: a book or list of names, facts, etc., usu. arranged in alphabetical order
examples: I couldn't find your number in the telephone [[directory]].

senses.en: help or support
examples: The work was completed with the [[assistance]] of local carpenters.

senses.zh: （使）（想法、主题等）难以区分，模糊
senses.en: make the difference between two ideas, subjects, etc. less clear
examples: She tends to [[blur]] the distinction between her friends and her colleagues.
The writing [[blurred]] and danced before his eyes.

senses.en: become difficult to see, or make sth. difficult to see, because the edges are not clear
examples: She tends to [[blur]] the distinction between her friends and her colleagues.
The writing [[blurred]] and danced before his eyes.

senses.en: a clear difference or separation between two similar things
examples: We need to draw a [[distinction]] between the two events, even though they are both related to financial issues.

senses.en: common at a particular time, in a particular place, or among a particular group of people
examples: One [[prevalent]] quality we have found in teens' statements about themselves is a strikingly positive emotional tone.

senses.en: the study of language in general and of particular languages, their structure, grammar, and history
examples: As a specialist in [[linguistics]], I have studied how the conversational styles of men and women differ.

senses.en: a word formed from the initial letters of other words
examples: More typically, [[acronyms]] are pronounced as new single words, as in UNESCO.

senses.zh: 大声笑（用于电子邮件、手机短信等中表示认为某事很好笑）
senses.en: (laughing out loud) used in emails, text messages, etc. to show that you think sth. is funny
examples: The dog kept running around chasing its tail. [[LOL]].

senses.en: the amount of time that sth. lasts
examples: By offering services to help expand the [[longevity]] of their products, they are promising quality and durability to consumers.
The new study appears to be the first to specifically look at the relationship between optimism and [[longevity]].

senses.en: the amount of time that sb. / sth. lives
examples: By offering services to help expand the [[longevity]] of their products, they are promising quality and durability to consumers.
The new study appears to be the first to specifically look at the relationship between optimism and [[longevity]].

senses.en: having the right to do or obtain sth.
examples: If you are a teenager living in certain parts of the province, you could be [[eligible]] for this program.

senses.en: (fml.) consider or discuss sth. again
examples: We need to [[revisit]] this proposal as soon as the budget is clearer.
Ten years later, I [[revisited]] the school to find out what had changed.

senses.en: (written) return to a place you once knew well
examples: We need to [[revisit]] this proposal as soon as the budget is clearer.
Ten years later, I [[revisited]] the school to find out what had changed.

senses.en: the way in which sth. is used, or the amount of it that is used
examples: It involves changing product quality, features, or style to attract new users or more [[usage]] from present users.
The dictionary focuses on the more usual words of the language and avoids rare [[usages]] of these words.

senses.en: the way that words are used in a language
examples: It involves changing product quality, features, or style to attract new users or more [[usage]] from present users.
The dictionary focuses on the more usual words of the language and avoids rare [[usages]] of these words.

senses.en: (only before noun) accepted by or involving most people in a society
examples: Our survey is intended to find out which [[mainstream]] car has the most appeal for both private and business buyers on a budget.
Environmental ideas have been absorbed into the [[mainstream]] of our politics.

senses.zh: （思想或方法的）主流；主流群体
senses.en: (the ~) the most usual ideas or methods, or the people who have these ideas or methods
examples: Our survey is intended to find out which [[mainstream]] car has the most appeal for both private and business buyers on a budget.
Environmental ideas have been absorbed into the [[mainstream]] of our politics.

senses.en: unclear or confused
examples: There's a [[fuzzy]] line between parents' and schools' responsibilities.
Some of the photos were so [[fuzzy]] that it was hard to tell who was who.

senses.en: not clear in shape or sound
examples: There's a [[fuzzy]] line between parents' and schools' responsibilities.
Some of the photos were so [[fuzzy]] that it was hard to tell who was who.

senses.en: when sth. new begins to exist or starts being used
examples: The industry has changed greatly with the [[appearance]] of new technologies.
We are often attracted to somebody first by their physical [[appearance]].

senses.en: the way sb. / sth. looks to other people
examples: The industry has changed greatly with the [[appearance]] of new technologies.
We are often attracted to somebody first by their physical [[appearance]].

senses.en: words and expressions used in a particular profession or by a particular group of people, which are difficult for other people to understand — often used to show disapproval
examples: I'm going to explain it without [[jargon]], and without making it unnecessarily complicated and complex.

senses.zh: 不受时间影响的；永不过时的
senses.en: not appearing to be affected by the process of time passing or by changes in fashion
examples: Lu Xun, an influential Chinese writer, essayist, and translator, produced that [[timeless]] classic, and many more.

senses.zh: 将（想法、信仰等）强加（于某人）
senses.en: force sb. to have the same ideas, beliefs, etc. as you
examples: I can't understand why she always tries to [[impose]] her own ideas on the rest of the team.
The court has the power to [[impose]] an unlimited fine for this offence.

senses.en: if sb. in authority imposes a rule, punishment, tax, etc., they force people to accept it
examples: I can't understand why she always tries to [[impose]] her own ideas on the rest of the team.
The court has the power to [[impose]] an unlimited fine for this offence.

senses.en: (~s) the things that you do not like
examples: A good hotel manager should know his regular guests' likes and [[dislikes]].
He simply [[disliked]] working with committees and avoided it whenever possible.

senses.en: think sb. / sth. is unpleasant and not like them
examples: A good hotel manager should know his regular guests' likes and [[dislikes]].
He simply [[disliked]] working with committees and avoided it whenever possible.

senses.en: (fml.) making you anxious
examples: The scientists report that some of the signs they have found are [[worrisome]].

senses.en: extremely interesting
examples: With the accompaniment of the piano, the poems sounded [[fascinating]] and became really popular.

senses.zh: （尤指以不同的方式）重新制作
senses.en: (remade, remade) make sth. again, esp. in a different way
examples: The mall has been moving aggressively to try to [[remake]] itself for a new era of shopping.

senses.zh: （问题，成功或冒险经历等）相当多的
senses.en: if one has had their fair share of sth., e.g. problems, success, or adventure, a lot of it has happened to them
examples: He'd had more than his fair share of adventure.

senses.en: be present for a short time and then go away
examples: The pain in my leg [[comes]] and [[goes]].

senses.en: move or happen faster, or make sth. move or happen faster
examples: The world's clock has [[sped up]] as nations around the globe are reinventing themselves at a faster and faster pace.

senses.en: through / by oral communication
examples: Much of this information is picked up by word of mouth from previous students.

senses.en: (infml.) remain in or near a place
examples: "Without hesitation, she replied, "I don't know. Let's [[stick around]] and find out."

senses.en: manage to do as much or as well as other people
examples: He found it difficult to [[keep up with]] the rest of the class.

senses.zh: 班戈大学（英国大学，位于威尔士）
